instruction_lines: Put the butter in the mixer and use speed 2.. Continue until butter is smooth
Add in egg.and once its mixed add in coffee mixture
Add in sugar..small portion at a time until all the sugar is used.comtinue with speed 2
Add in flour in small portion and repear as how you do it with the sugar
U can use any cookie cutter you like and sprinkle coffee powder.but i didnt as i dont want to overpower it
